title: 第11章 来妖不善被围了第12章 被绑入山群妖围观
content_zh:
莫凡震惊了片刻后，眼中便流露出了一抹杀机，看那妖怪的去向，只怕是那黑风山中的小妖。
眼下已然结仇，若真的令其回到山里乱嚼舌根，怕是会引来祸端。
想到这里，他便再度吐出一支箭矢，搭在大弓上，直接瞄准那只鸟妖。
稍顷，莫凡却又将弓箭放下。
“罢了，眼下那鸟妖已经飞远，以这柄大弓之力只怕也难以将其射杀，反而坐实了要射杀对方的举动，招来杀身之祸……”
莫凡自语，目光闪动，最终张口施展吞天神通将弓箭收入体内空间。
“蛤蟆老爷，俺们不逃吗？那鸟妖明显是去搬救兵了，这可咋办啊？！”
兔妖此刻却是急了，它虽然蠢萌，但并不是真的愚笨，知道那鸟妖极有可能就是黑风山的妖怪。
“还能咋办，凉拌呗！”
莫凡翻了翻白眼，直接翻身骑上了二哈的虎背，淡淡道：“咱们是来投奔黑风山的，刚刚那只是一个误会，如果这里领头的妖怪是个明事理的主，应该不会把咱们怎么样。”
“可若那领头大妖不是明事理的主呢？”兔妖问道。
“这……”莫凡愣了愣，旋即不耐烦地摆了摆手，“到时候再说吧！”
他好不容易才盼来了这么个机会，自然不肯就此放弃。
莫凡已经想好了，如果对方真的要追究，那自己就赔偿对方那种乳白色的石头好了。
听那老猎人说是仙家事物，那石头肯定价值不凡，就是不知道这里的妖怪能否识得石头的价值了。
危险与机遇并存，莫凡已经做好了一个赌徒心理，他好不容易才从一只癞蛤蟆化妖，好不容易才找到了这么个妖怪山，自是不甘心就这么算了。
而且若是这黑风山里真的有了不得的大妖要追究自己，难道自己此时就真的跑得掉吗？
明知山有虎偏向虎山行，就为了赌一个前程！
赌赢了就从此过上舒舒服服的妖怪生活，说不定以后还能混个妖王来当当，岂不快哉？
至于会不会赌输，莫凡却是没有去想过，大不了回炉重造呗！

就这样，怀着这样的决心，他毅然的朝黑风山而去。
“兔子，你如果怕死，现在就走吧，省得待会儿拖累了你。”莫凡对兔妖说道。
“蛤蟆老爷都不怕，那俺也不怕！”
“蛤蟆老爷你之前救过俺，俺怎么能够抛弃你逃走？”兔妖一脸真诚的道。
“好样的！”
莫凡闻言倒是有些高兴，他没想到这兔妖还挺讲义气的。
“再说了，那鸟妖是蛤蟆老爷你射伤的，与俺有什么关系？”兔妖补充道。
“你大爷的！”
莫凡听到这话却是被气得不轻，感情这兔妖不是讲义气，是他娘的没心没肺！
“蛤蟆老爷，你大爷的是什么意思啊？”兔妖不解道。
“你大爷的就是……嗯，就是你大爷的！”
“可俺还是不太懂，你能说得明白些吗？”
“就是你好的意思。”
莫凡无奈地胡诌了一句，他开始有些嫌弃这个啰嗦的蠢萌兔妖了。
“原来你大爷的就是你好啊？”
“蛤蟆老爷，你大爷的！”
兔妖一脸天真的开口，脸上还露出一抹人畜无害的微笑来。
“我特么……”
莫凡无语了，他没想到自己随口一句话竟把自己给坑了。
content_en:
After Mo Fan was shocked for a moment, there was a murderous intent in his eyes. Judging from where the monster was going, he was afraid it was the little monster in the Black Wind Mountain.
Now that he has become enemies, if he is really allowed to go back to the mountains to gossip, it will probably lead to disaster.
Thinking of this, he spit out another arrow, put it on the big bow, and aimed directly at the bird demon.
After a while, Mo Fan put down his bow and arrow again.
"Forget it, the bird demon has flown far away now, and I am afraid that it will be difficult to kill it with the power of this big bow. Instead, I am determined to shoot the opponent, which will lead to death..."
Mo Fan muttered to himself, his eyes flashed, and finally he opened his mouth to use the Heaven-Swallowing Magical Power to put the bow and arrow into the space inside his body.
"Master Toad, don't we run away? The bird demon is obviously going to bring in reinforcements. What should we do?!"
The rabbit demon was anxious at this moment. Although it was cute, it was not really stupid. It knew that the bird demon was most likely the monster from Black Wind Mountain.
"What else can I do? Let's eat it cold!"
Mo Fan rolled his eyes, turned over and rode on Er Ha's tiger's back, and said calmly: "We are here to defect to Black Wind Mountain. It was just a misunderstanding. If the leading monster here is a sensible master, he shouldn't do anything to us."
"But what if the leading demon is not a wise master?" the rabbit demon asked.
"This..." Mo Fan was stunned for a moment, then waved his hand impatiently, "Let's talk about it then!"
He had finally been looking forward to this opportunity, so he naturally refused to give up.
Mo Fan has already thought about it. If the other party really wants to pursue the case, then he will compensate the other party for the milky white stone.
I heard that the old hunter said it was a thing of the immortal family, so the stone must be of great value, but I don't know if the monsters here can recognize the value of the stone.
Danger and opportunity coexisted, and Mo Fan had already prepared a gambler's mentality. He finally transformed from a toad into a monster, and finally found such a monster mountain, so he couldn't bear to let it go.
And if there really is a powerful demon in this Black Wind Mountain who wants to pursue him, can he really run away now?
Knowing that there are tigers in the mountains, we traveled to the Tiger Mountains just to gamble on our future!
If you win the bet, you will live a comfortable life as a monster from now on. Maybe you can become a monster king in the future. Wouldn't it be nice?
As for whether he would lose the bet, Mo Fan never thought about it. At worst, he would have to go back to the drawing board and remake it!
In this way, with such determination, he resolutely headed towards Heifeng Mountain.
"Rabbit, if you are afraid of death, leave now to avoid dragging you down later." Mo Fan said to the rabbit demon.
"If Master Toad isn't afraid, then I'm not afraid either!"
"Master Toad, you have saved me before, how could I abandon you and run away?" the rabbit demon said sincerely.
"Well done!"
Mo Fan was a little happy when he heard this. He didn't expect that this rabbit demon was quite loyal.
"Besides, that bird demon was shot by Mr. Toad. What does it have to do with me?" the rabbit demon added.
"Your uncle's!"
Mo Fan was very angry when he heard this. This rabbit demon is not loyal, but heartless!
"Master Toad, what does your uncle mean?" the rabbit demon asked in confusion.
"Your uncle's is... well, it's your uncle's!"
"But I still don't quite understand. Can you explain it more clearly?"
"That's what you mean."
Mo Fan mumbled helplessly. He began to dislike this long-winded and cute rabbit demon.
"So it turns out that your uncle's business is yours, okay?"
"Master Toad, it belongs to you!"
The rabbit demon spoke innocently, with a harmless smile on his face.
"What the hell..."
Mo Fan was speechless. He didn't expect that his casual words would trick him.
